BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Brutal Dragon Decel!!
This must be the dragon.\nIt has huge black stuff on its body and
it looks just like the Eerie Crystal in Isthmus\nof Kaus...
Heeey! Are you alright?!
Are you injured?!
So, this dragon has been troubling people...
Looks tough to beat...\nWe can back you up if you need!
Please, don't hold back!
U... Ugg... Where am I...?\nWhat am I doing...?
?! W-What's going on...
It was just roaring all the time until\na while ago...
Who's there? ...Hmm, I only remember that I woke\nup to a voice calling me. I don't remember\nanything after that...
What?! I've been troubling people?!\nNo way. I'm Decel. The dragon in the desert.
People who walk through the desert have much\nrespect for me, and I've been watching out for\ntheir safety and protecting them.
I have no good reason to fight you humans.\nWhy would I even trouble people...?
Hey, look at his body.
...The black crystal stuff on his body is gone\nbefore we know it.
You lost your memory... I guess the black crystal\nhas something to do with it.
I was unconcious but...\nI've caused a lot of troubles to humans...\nI have to pay for it.
I'll go back to the desert and wait for the\ncommand from the 12 gods.
I apologize to all the human beings for what I've\ndone. Could you tell the people that I said so...?
Excellent!\nHe might have been controlled but you defeated\na fierce dragon like that!
You must be a famous warrior, aren't you?\nWhat do you think, Balft?
Y-Yea but...You were off guard several times\nduring the battle. He could have got you.\nYou still have much to learn!
Balft! Don't talk like that. ...I'm sorry.\nHe must be jealous because you defeated the\ndragon.
N-No way...
Well, let's go back to the city. You?\n...I see. You must report it to Pino.\nBut there are too many things to explain, right?
I know you can't do this alone.\nSo, we'll go with you and report it, too.\nWhat do you think, Triel?
Balft, you're not planning to get the share of the\nreward from Pino, are you?
Whoa?! N-No way!\nI-I just feel the need to give precise information\nabout the dragon and...
Tee hee. Sure. Just kidding..\nLet's go.
Is there anything left undone?\n[ffff64]*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. I'll go down the mountain!
Explore here a little longer.
